title: You Must Leave It Behind
preview_description: Written as part of a writing challenge much like a game jam, the title only was generated by a game-jam style prompt.
blurb:
Cairo, 1798. An occupied city holds its breath. However, for some the weight of their past presses harder than any foreign power could.

Victor, a young thief moves through the ancient city slowly being hollowed out for its riches, and when an opportunity arrises offering to free him from the guilt he has been holding, what more can he do but consider it?

A short, crushing tale of colonial plunder, greed, and guilt, this novella explores the reality of what happens when we chase after what we think we need, and the consequences of what we leave behind.
